INTRO_STORY:
I am the healer. Listen to the story of Kimeria.

In the days of King Rufardus the Wise, the witch L'Kardina came to our kingdom. She had been banished from a neighboring land. When Kimeria tried to drive her away as well, her fury became a terrible curse.

The sun ceased to shine. Darkness swallowed the kingdom, and eternal night settled over its sleeping lands.

Word of Kimeria's misfortune reached a wandering warrior named Edgard. He set out on a long journey to overthrow the witch and save the kingdom.

On his way, he met me, an old healer. Beyond our meeting lay unfamiliar paths and cunning traps. I gave him my counsel, and he ventured onward.

Here begins Edgard's journey through the sleeping kingdom.
ENDING_STORY:
Edgard has defeated every enemy.

The kingdom is free of monsters.

Light has returned to the world.

THE END
HEALER_GREETING: Edgard, the forest guardian blocks your way. I can brew an elixir to strengthen your sword against him, but it won't affect magical items.
HEALER_RETURN_CHECK: Now then, the elixir needs Bat, Mushroom and every coin from this forest. Let's see what you've brought me.
EDGARD_REPLY: What do you need for the elixir?
HEALER_INGREDIENTS: The recipe needs Bat and Mushroom. You are missing ingredients. Check the list; payment also needs every coin from this forest.
HEALER_PAYMENT: You have the ingredients, but not enough payment. Bring every coin from this forest; coins from earlier lands do not count.
HEALER_BOTH: You are missing ingredients and payment. Bring Bat, Mushroom and every coin from this forest. The list shows what is still missing.
HEALER_READY: I see you have everything: the bat, the mushroom, and all the forest's coins. I'll brew your elixir now. Drink it: your sword strikes against this boss will be ten times stronger.
HEALER_OFFER: I can send you to the forest entrance to collect what you missed. Or face him without the elixir. Once the fight begins, there is no way back.
HEALER_PAID: The bat, mushroom, and all the forest's coins have been handed over as payment. You drink the elixir. Your sword now deals ten times more damage to the boss. But the elixir only boosts your physical strength.
HEALER_LOCK: Defeat him to open the way onward. The elixir lasts through this battle and its retries, then ends with his defeat.
HEALER_VICTORY: The forest guardian is defeated, Edgard. You have opened the way ahead.
EDGARD_DARKNESS: But darkness still hangs over the kingdom.
HEALER_GUIDE: Your journey continues. I will be your guide. Go on: we will meet again.
ABOUT_RULES: One hit kills; attempts are unlimited. Retry from this room; new pickups roll back, secured ones stay kept. Tap jump for each jump. Assist extends trap warnings.
HINT_TUTORIAL_WALK: Walk right to find the way out
HINT_LEVER_TORCH: This lever lights the torch and puts it out
HINT_LEVER_EXIT: The exit is ahead. The lever works any time
HINT_LADDER_LEVER: This lever lowers the ladder and raises it again
HINT_LADDER_CLIMB: Climb the ladder when it is down
HINT_WALL_LEVER: This lever raises the wall and lowers it again
HINT_WALL_PASS: Walk under the wall once it is raised
HINT_PLATFORM_LEVER: This lever starts the platform and stops it again
HINT_PLATFORM_RIDE: Jump on the platform and ride it up to the exit
HINT_STONE_THROW: Take the stone to the edge of the chasm and throw it at the lever
HINT_STONE_EXIT: Hit the lever with the stone, then ride the platform across
HINT_TRAP_PLATFORM: The platform falls soon after you land. Falling into the pit just retries
HINT_TRAP_STUMP: A touched stump smokes, then explodes. Jump over it or run clear
HEALER_TALE_ROAD: Edgard, the road ahead is short, yet it is a tale all the same. Hear it before you walk it.
EDGARD_TALE_NO_TIME: A tale? The kingdom waits, and I have no time for stories.
HEALER_TALE_FAIRIES: In this wood a sleeping fairy wakes the torch with a touch, a ladder is let down for kind hands, and a stubborn wall rises when the right spell is spoken.
HEALER_TALE_LIFT: A golden boat of the air carries the bold over the dark gap. A far-off fairy can be woken by a stone sent like a wish. Do not be afraid to ask.
HEALER_TALE_WITCH: Beware the gifts of the wicked witch: a bridge that crumbles and a berry that bursts. Answer her riddles with quick feet, and the wood will let you pass.
EDGARD_TALE_UNDERSTOOD: I understand, old man. Now let me go, the kingdom cannot wait.
HEALER_TALE_PRAISE: Well done, Edgard. The enchanted wood has told you all its tales, and you have solved every one of its riddles.
EDGARD_TALE_READY: Then I am ready for the road?
HEALER_TALE_HEROES: Ready as the heroes of old tales, who were afraid and went on all the same. A true warrior needs no more than that.
HEALER_TALE_BLESSING: Take my blessing: walk lightly, look keenly, and look twice at any path that seems too kind, for witches smile the sweetest. May the fairies light your road.
